methodology.position: Geometric region center; rainfall-weighted centroid also reported.
methodology.core_separation: Optional 5 mm/h seed components (at least 16 km²) grow into connected ≥1 mm/h rain by priority flood; minimum area is applied after partitioning.
methodology.matching: Geometric displacement limited to 40 km/h. Overlap of at least 20% of the smaller region forms topology links. Continuations require score ≥0.6; no-overlap links also require mutual best match with margin ≥0.12.
methodology.score: Overlap matches: 0.35 overlap fraction + 0.35 predicted proximity + 0.20 area similarity + 0.10 mean-intensity similarity. No-overlap matches: 0.60 predicted proximity + 0.25 area similarity + 0.15 intensity similarity. Heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
methodology.lineage: Splits, merges and many-to-many reorganizations create new IDs; parent links record overlap associations, not proof of physical identity. Unresolved links and missing/dry intervals are not bridged.
methodology.scope: Track IDs apply only within this event, source and settings. Threshold crossings, core partitioning, hourly sampling and grid-edge clipping can create apparent structural changes.
